reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is consistent with known effects of moderate heat treatment on microstructure and oxidation behavior, though the specific role of copper in the oxide scale and nanotwin formation introduces some uncertainty.
reasons.testability: A clear side-by-side comparison of as-sprayed and 500 °C heat-treated coatings under controlled high-temperature wear tests offers a direct way to either confirm or refute the proposed mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis directly targets a crucial challenge—high-temperature wear—and proposes a feasible processing route and metrics to assess its effectiveness, making it highly relevant to coatings research in this area.
